activeRootPolicy: Active/current manifests stay visible at the category root. Non-current, planning, lineage, deferred, generated, denied, and execution records are nested by maturity class.

maturityClasses.active: Current preferred manifest for planning/tool discovery/use; never runtime approval by itself.
maturityClasses.lineage: Earlier intake, source inventory, region mapping, candidate, or superseded record kept for provenance.
maturityClasses.planning: Plans, selections, designs, placement plans, composition plans, font plans, organization plans, and tool plans.
maturityClasses.generated: Generated output derived from source manifests or tooling.

runtimeBoundaryNotes: Reviewed does not imply runtime approval.
Lineage files are preserved provenance and must not be deleted casually.
Generated files are not automatically source of truth.
Runtime/game wiring remains outside H5.91A scope.
H5.99 wires typography only in the Hub and Button Goblin with human visual review passed; no broader game/runtime approval is implied.
H6.4 selectively proves shared host surfaces in Button Goblin only; Region 20 and Region 30 remain human-review gated and Region 5 remains rejected.

H5.100 records a licensed Potion Sorter source-material shortlist for H5.101 neutral-specimen audition only; it does not approve runtime textures, SceneRig composition, shaders/PBR, particles, glass/liquid implementation, or room construction.

H5.100C adds stylized-fantasy source identity beside H5.100 realistic support. Metal008 is a restrained focal contrast accent; no H5.100C source is runtime-approved before H5.101 neutral-specimen review.

H5.102A human review approved direct material bindings, H5.48C sprite frames, actor/holder ownership, and containment/interaction contracts for runtime preparation only. It does not authorize runtime asset registration, gameplay replacement, emitters, shaders, or alpha-mask fabrication; it authorizes only the separately bounded preview-only H6 SceneRig lane.
